_comment: The game's vocabulary. A card names a mechanic; this explains it ONCE, in the card inspector. Before this file every card re-taught its own rules on the face, which is why card text kept growing (design/feel-and-readability.md). Keywords are DERIVED from a card's fields by GameHost._keywords_of — no card has to declare them, so a new card gets the right tooltips for free.

timed.name: Timed
timed.text: Play it on the sweeping bar. A dead-centre hit pays the bonus in full, catching the edge of the same bright zone pays half, and missing it entirely leaves the card with no effect at all.

poison.name: Poison
poison.text: The beast bleeds this much at the start of each of its turns. It does not wear off.

expose.name: Expose
expose.text: Each stack makes one incoming hit deal 4 more. Stacks are spent as they are used — and they bank while you are below the weak point.

rhythm.name: Rhythm
rhythm.text: Goes up by 1 every time you land a timed card this turn. Resets at the end of your turn, so Rhythm cards want to be chained in one go.

strength.name: Strength
strength.text: Adds to every attack you play for the rest of the fight.

dexterity.name: Dexterity
dexterity.text: Adds to every source of Block you gain for the rest of the fight. Reduced by Frail like any other Block.

block.name: Block
block.text: Absorbs damage before your health. It clears at the start of your next turn, so it is worth spending, not saving.

height.name: Height
height.text: How far up the beast you have climbed. The weak point sits at the top — see Armoured.

armoured.name: Armoured
armoured.text: Below the weak point the hide takes only a quarter of your damage, and Expose stacks bank instead of being spent. Climb to the sigil before you commit a big hit.

grip.name: Grip
grip.text: A live timer that drains whenever you are between holds. Reach a ledge or the sigil before it empties or you fall to the base.

taunt.name: Taunt
taunt.text: The beast targets you this round instead of your ally.

burn.name: Burn
burn.text: The card is removed for the rest of this fight. Some Goblin cards get stronger for every card burned.

enchant.name: Enchanted
enchant.text: A named effect attached to this one card. What it does is printed on the card itself.

energy.name: Energy
energy.text: What you spend to play cards. Both hunters get a fresh 3 each round and unspent Energy does not carry over — a card that hands some to your ally lets them spend it right now, on your turn.

build.name: Build
build.text: Adds a new card straight into your hand — not your draw or discard pile — so you can play it this turn if you have the energy for it.

prime.name: Primed
prime.text: Arms a delayed effect that fires the instant your next turn begins, before you draw.

cheapen.name: Cheapen
cheapen.text: Permanently cuts the chosen card's cost for the rest of this fight — it comes back cheaper every time you draw it again.

meld.name: Meld
meld.text: Fuses two cards from your hand into one new card carrying everything both did, for one less energy than their costs added together.

multistrike.name: Multistrike
multistrike.text: The damage lands more than once, as separate hits — each one can spend an Expose stack or land at a reached weak point on its own.

status.name: Status
status.text: A dead card. It does nothing for you and cannot be sharpened — only removed, at a campfire or shop.

retain.name: Retain
retain.text: Stays in your hand at the end of the turn instead of being discarded.

innate.name: Innate
innate.text: Guaranteed to be in your opening hand at the start of every fight.

ethereal.name: Ethereal
ethereal.text: Burns away — exhausted for the rest of the fight — if it is still in your hand when your turn ends.

x_cost.name: X
x_cost.text: Spends ALL your remaining energy when played. Its damage or Block scales with how much you spent.

frail.name: Frail
frail.text: Block gained while this is stacked is reduced by a quarter. Artifact can ward it off before it lands.

thorns.name: Thorns
thorns.text: A direct attack landed on the carrier reflects this much damage back at whoever threw it.

artifact.name: Artifact
artifact.text: One stack blocks one debuff — Expose, Poison, or Frail — before it lands, then is spent.

intangible.name: Intangible
intangible.text: Any hit that gets past your Block is capped at 1 damage, then one stack is spent. Block still works exactly as normal — this only limits what gets through.

buffer.name: Buffer
buffer.text: The next hit that gets past your Block is cancelled outright, then one stack is spent. Stronger than Intangible, so it's used up first if you have both.

plated_armour.name: Plated Armour
plated_armour.text: Block that survives the round instead of resetting to 0 — it only decays by 1 when a hit still gets HP through despite it.

light.name: Light
light.text: The Lightbearer's own resource. It banks across turns instead of resetting — some cards fill it, others spend it for a bigger effect.

mend.name: Mend
mend.text: Heals your ally directly, up to their max health.

power.name: Power
power.text: Never discarded once played — it stays in play for the rest of the fight, and its effect fires again at the end of every one of your turns, including this one. Playing a second copy stacks it.

scry.name: Scry
scry.text: Look at the top cards of your draw pile and bin any of them — your ally sees the reveal too. Whatever you keep stays on top, in the same order.

discard.name: Discard
discard.text: Sends cards straight to your discard pile without playing them. Some cards get stronger for every card sitting in your discard pile — including the ones your hand loses at the end of every turn, not just ones you discarded on purpose.

cleave.name: Cleave
cleave.text: Deals its damage to the Titan AND every one of its adds still standing, instead of a single target.

reach.name: Reach
reach.text: Touches your OWN draw pile directly instead of just drawing from it — puts a card on top, shuffles one in at random, or pulls a named card straight into your hand.

keywords._comment_moves: Below: the beast's telegraphed moves. Same vocabulary rules as the cards — the intent tag NAMES the move and prints its number, and the explanation lives here, one right-click away. Ids match the move `type` in bosses.json. Added 2026-08-16: the tag had started explaining itself inline ('Sweep 8 — hits you both'), which is the card-text problem all over again.

attack.name: Attack
attack.text: A single hunter, the one the beast is turned toward. Your Block comes off it first.

attack_all.name: Sweep
attack_all.text: Hits BOTH hunters for the full amount, and shakes each of you down to the hold below. Block on one of you does nothing for the other.

swipe_high.name: Lash the flank
swipe_high.text: Only catches hunters off the ground. Standing at the base is the safe place to be this round.

swipe_low.name: Stamp
swipe_low.text: Only catches hunters still on the ground. Anyone already climbing is above it.

leech.name: Drain
leech.text: Hits the hunter it is turned toward, and the beast heals for what it takes.

rift.name: Wrench apart
rift.text: Hits both hunters, and gets worse the further apart you are — 2 more damage for every Height between you. Climb together and it is just the base number.

block.name: Defend
block.text: The beast guards. Damage comes off its Block before its health, and the Block is gone by its next turn.

enrage.name: Enrage
enrage.text: Permanently raises every attack it makes for the rest of the fight. A soft timer: the longer the fight runs, the harder it hits.

regen.name: Recover
regen.text: The beast heals. Damage you have already dealt is not lost, but the clock just moved against you.

shift_sigil.name: Shift its sigil
shift_sigil.text: The weak point moves to a new Height, and any damage banked into the old one is lost. Whatever you climbed may now be the wrong place.
